Our Story

A Legacy Built on Quality

Britain Paints was founded in 1992 in Lahore by three visionary partners Mr. Masood Ahmed, Mr. Shafiq Ahmed, and Mr. Sabir (Late). Born with a clear mission to deliver superior quality paint at affordable prices, the brand quickly earned a reputation that spread across Pakistan.

The name "Britain Paints" was coined by Mr. Muhammad Zubair the founding sole distributor and father of Mr. Junaid Zubair of Meer Traders, Rawalpindi. Today, led by Mr. Hamza Masood, Britain Paints continues this proud legacy with renewed vision and an unwavering commitment to quality.

🏭 Est. 1992 · Lahore ✅ Premium Quality 💰 Economical Prices 🤝 30+ Years of Trust

Our Range

Premium Paint Products

A complete range of high-quality coatings for every surface from interior walls to outdoor protection.

⭐ Featured
Flagship Product

Synthetic Enamel Gloss

Britain's premium oil-modified alkyd enamel delivers a rich mirror-like gloss on wood, metal, and walls. The New Improved Formula with Pro Cover technology ensures superior coverage in fewer coats saving time and cost. Anti-fungal, stain-resistant, and weather-durable; it outperforms competitor brands at the same price point.

High GlossPro CoverAnti-FungalWood & MetalFast Dry
Economy Range

EcomaX Economy Enamel

Britain EcomaX is a revolutionary economy synthetic enamel that delivers a smooth, glossy finish at the most budget-friendly price. Ideal for large painting projects where cost-efficiency matters. Suitable for wood, metal, and wall surfaces both indoors and outdoors quality you can trust at a price that makes sense.

EconomyGloss FinishBudget FriendlyAll Surfaces
Matt Finish

Matt Enamel

A sophisticated alternative to gloss Britain Matt Enamel delivers a smooth, elegant matte finish on wood, metal, and walls. Designed to bring understated refinement and durability to any surface. Excellent adhesion, rich coverage, and strong resistance to daily wear and humidity make it perfect for both interior and exterior use.

Matt FinishElegant LookDurableAll Surfaces
Interior Walls

Super Emulsion

Britain Super Emulsion Premium Series is a water-based interior wall finish delivering extraordinary coverage with rich, vibrant colours. Eco-friendly, anti-fungal, and washable it provides a luxurious smooth finish for drawing rooms, bedrooms, and offices. Available in a wide spectrum of shades via the Mix System.

Premium SeriesEco FriendlyWashableMix System
Exterior Protection

Weather Shield

100% Acrylic Based exterior paint engineered for Pakistan's harsh climate. Britain Weather Shield inhibits mould growth, provides excellent coverage, and maintains a smooth flat finish that resists cracking, peeling, and dampness. Premium Series with the Mix System for customised exterior colour matching.

100% AcrylicWaterproofAnti-MouldPremium Series
Wood Care

Synthetic Clear Varnish

An eco-friendly, alkyd-based clear varnish that preserves and protects natural wood grain with a brilliant gloss finish. Forms a tough, flexible film that resists moisture, scratches, and daily wear ideal for furniture, doors, wooden panels, and flooring. Easy brush or spray application with excellent flow and levelling.

Eco FriendlyCrystal ClearMoisture ResistWood Surfaces
Premium Series

Metallic Finish

Britain Metallic Finish Premium Series is specially formulated for wood and metal surfaces, delivering a stunning metallic sheen with long-lasting durability. Eco-friendly coating that resists rust, weather, and wear — perfect for railings, grills, doors, and furniture.

Premium Metallic Sheen Eco Friendly Wood & Metal
Base Coat

Primer & Undercoat

Britain Oil-Based Primer is a high-performance undercoat for wood, metal, and masonry surfaces. It penetrates deeply to create a strongly bonded base that prevents rust, moisture ingress, and dramatically extends the life of the final topcoat. An essential first step for any professional paint job ensuring lasting results.

Anti-RustWood & MetalDeep PenetrationLong Lasting
Gloss Finish

Synthetic Enamel Premium Box

Available in both the classic tin and the premium box packaging Britain Synthetic Enamel is specially formulated for interior and exterior metal, wood, and wall surfaces, giving them a touch of brilliance and breathing colourful life into your home. Provides lasting beauty in harsh weather and helps prevent fungus growth.

Premium PackInterior & ExteriorAnti-FungalAll Weather
